channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Frank Jackson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Frank Jackson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Wayne Ellington, Frank Jackson
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Frank Jackson:

“He's worked hard this summer and that's what Frank does. He's active. I think he learned from Wayne Ellington on how to move without the ball. His activity on the offensive end is hard to keep up with.”

Dwane Casey on Wayne Ellington, Frank Jackson, Oct 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Frank Jackson
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Frank Jackson:

“He's worked hard every day, really didn't get an opportunity early in the season and now we're able to evaluate what he is,who he is and really happy about what we saw the other night.”

Dwane Casey on Frank Jackson, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dell Demps on Frank Jackson
item.description:
Dell Demps on Frank Jackson (13 pts in 13 minutes prior to left ankle sprain) in summer league:

“We were disappointed he was injured in the first game. He gave us a little taste. But he's a gritty guy. It was good to see a little bit of it, but wish we could've seen more.”

Dell Demps on Frank Jackson, Jul 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson
item.description:
#Pelicans summer coach Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson prior to ankle sprain:

“He looked really good. (Toronto’s defense) couldn’t keep him in front of them. It was really, really impressive to watch, actually... I liked what he was doing, the way he was moving and attacking.”

Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson
item.description:
#Pelicans summer head coach Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson:

“Super explosive, looks really good. His rhythm will probably be a little off (at first), but we're going to try to get it there quickly...being able to guard the ball, he can be an elite defender in this league, I think”

Kevin Hanson on Frank Jackson, Jul 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Dell Demps on Frank Jackson, Cheick Diallo
item.description:
Dell Demps on #Pelicans young players:

“We're excited about Frank Jackson moving forward. You saw flashes of Cheick Diallo this year. We're hoping those guys can really be impact players for next year. The potential is there, the work ethic is there.”

Dell Demps on Frank Jackson, Cheick Diallo, May 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
